failure.identity: mtg-sets	com.wingedsheep.mtg.sets.CardLintTest	every card's pipeline variables, target bindings, and choice slots resolve
failure.message: org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError: List should be empty but has 1 elements, first being: "[OGW] 'Reckless Bushwhacker': CastChoiceMade reads choice slot SELF_ALTERNATIVE, but nothing on the card declares it (EntersWithChoice / kicker / blight / sneak). The read would always come back empty."

primary_cause: CardLinter.collectSlots does not declare SELF_ALTERNATIVE for an actual CardScript.selfAlternativeCost. The new card's CastChoiceMade(SELF_ALTERNATIVE) read is therefore classified UndeclaredChoiceSlotRead by checkSlots, causing the unchanged corpus-wide CardLintTest assertion at line46 to fail.

causal_source.finding: A real selfAlternativeCost object is declared; ETB intervening-if reads SELF_ALTERNATIVE.
Bushwhacker snapshot contains script.selfAlternativeCost object and CastChoiceMade SELF_ALTERNATIVE; that object has no type:SelfAlternativeCost tag.
Defaults are materialized. Existing collector declares known typed nodes, Kicker and nonnull kickerSpellEffect, but no SELF_ALTERNATIVE rule; checkSlots rejects undeclared reads.
Engine writes SELF_ALTERNATIVE Flag into the durable cast-choice bag when the spell explicitly selected AlternativeCostType.SELF_ALTERNATIVE.
CastChoiceMade has explicit SELF_ALTERNATIVE handling with origin-generation-aware original-object information.

environment_classification.note: Gradle reports failing tests and MarkedVerificationException; no host failure establishes this stop. The wrapper warning about shlock is not the primary cause; the frozen launcher held the standard exclusive Manual flock.

console_count_limitation.resolution: Use exact raw XML identities/multiplicities and internally consistent XML header counts. Cause of the Gradle console aggregate discrepancy was not investigated; no row is missing or extra against the frozen401-row inventory.

next_step_proposal.scope: Prospective generic CardLinter support and additive dedicated regression tests only; retain original corpus assertion/allowlist and all semantic card/engine bytes.
next_step_proposal.rule: A real nonnull selfAlternativeCost object owned by the card/face script may declare SELF_ALTERNATIVE; absence/null must not declare it.

a real selfAlternativeCost does not declare KICKED
